reviews.review:
Fantasy knockoff of Into the Breach. I'm recommending because it's cheap and new. This is an amazing game for $3. 

Visuals and sound are good, but interactions with the UI feel kind of sticky in general. The game constantly asks you to press space to confirm actions, which is sort of overkill as it turns into muscle memory and it gets easy to be hasty with it.

This game is about metaprogression, and the grind is slow. There have been a ton of situations where it simply was not possible to control the outcome due to numerical advantages. I am sure this balance changes with further unlocks, but I'd rather play games that reward skill progression rather than time invested. By the time I'm unlocking new and interesting classes, I'm getting a bit too tired of the imbalance to want to go much further.
